conditions: Earth and Venus Proxima are unlocked by default; Saturn Proxima needs one Railjack Intrinsic at rank 3, and is optional here since Venus alone covers the farm.
Epitaph is Sevagoth's signature sidearm from Call of the Tempestarii — there is no Entrati or Necralisk vendor involved, despite what older write-ups assume.

groups.sub: Bifrost Echo or Beacon Shield Ring
conditions: The roll is one chance at end of mission regardless of length — the shortest completed mission wins every time, so skip the endless nodes.
Aborting or failing the mission voids that mission's roll entirely.
Earth and Saturn Proxima are 100% Skirmish nodes (long, multi-objective); Venus is the only region with a short Exterminate or Volatile node.
bonuses: Every run also pays Corrupted Holokeys, MK3 Railjack parts, relics and Endo — Epitaph is a side effect of a Holokey farm, not a trip of its own.
Joining as a client skips the whole Railjack-building problem and still collects MK3 parts for free.

disclosures.title: the Void Sinks are the real threat
disclosures.body: They deal radial Impact and one-shot squishy frames. Shield gating (Rolling Guard, Augur set) or a Voidrig Necramech handles them outright, and Frost's Snow Globe, Limbo's Cataclysm or Gara's Mass Vitrify absorb sinks that land outside the bubble.
